subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A bike left badly may save one rider ten seconds but cost many people time and safety.”?
options: Helping it requires knowledge, not slogans.
Sometimes discipline becomes a lesson for people watching.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Helping it requires knowledge, not slogans.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes discipline becomes a lesson for people watching.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A bike left badly may save one rider ten seconds but cost many people time and safety. Public convenience requires public discipline.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Walking online requires care.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A bike left badly may save one rider ten seconds but cost many people time and safety. Public convenience requires public discipline.」，答案為「Public convenience requires public discipline.」。
